154: 		c1 := -1
155: 
156: 		for j, p2 := range pathsParts {

159: 			}

167: 				if v != p2[i] {

169: 				}

171: 				c2 = i
172: 			}
173: 
174: 			if c1 == -1 || (c2 != -1 && c2 < c1) {

204: 			}

206: 			p = strings.TrimPrefix(p, g)

212: 		ns.Slice = UniqueStrings(ExtractRootPaths(ns.Slice))
